subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box.
stimulus: shout carry be go become hurry get pull try It (a) ______ a market day yesterday. The weather (b) ______ worse. People have to (c) ______ by boat to market. A boatman (d) ______ the boat. Everybody was (e) ______ to (f) ______ into the boat. The boatman was (g) ______ all the time not to be (h) ______. There (i) ______ too many people. A single boat could not (j) ______ all the people in one trip.
guide_solution: Right forms of verbs: (a) was (b) became (c) go (d) was pulling (e) trying (f) get (g) shouting (h) hurried (i) were (j) carry
